One constraint per latent construct needed identify construct zero point (.e., latent mean). default, fix latent means 0 time points "intercepts" long_partial, fix latent mean 0 first time point "intercepts" long_partial. Hierarchical principle: loading indicator particular time point free (.e., latent variable time interaction present), corresponding intercept (.e., main/marginal effect) free well. unique variance (aka "residuals") can held equal across time points even loadings intercepts constrained equal.

Alternatively, element can list \(q\) integer vectors, specifying indicators load latent variable. list length 1 provided, pattern used across time points. default NULL, assumes one latent variable per time point, indicators load . data, .fit, ordered, allow.empty.cell lavaan::lavOptions(). model character string showing additional syntax added model.
